## Problem

What problem would this feature solve? What are you trying to do?

## Proposed Solution

How you imagine it working.

## Alternatives Considered

Other ways you've thought about solving this.

## Scope Check

This extension deliberately renders **locally only** — features that require Java, a PlantUML server, or any network access are out of scope. If your idea touches that boundary (e.g., remote `!include`), please say how it could stay local.

## Additional Context

Sketches, example diagrams, links.
